name: Sparrow Link Health – Find & Fix Broken Links
author: sparrowplugins

sections.description:
Sparrow Link Health checks the links in your published posts and pages and lists the ones that no longer work: 404 pages, sites that are gone, links that time out.

Checks run on your own site in small background batches, once per URL even if fifty posts use it. You fix a link from the list without opening the editor.

Free features

  • Scans posts, pages and any public post type you pick
  • Edit a URL, unlink it (the text stays) or recheck it
  • Dismiss false alarms
  • Rescans a post when you update it
  • Skip domains you never want checked

Pro

Pro adds:

  • Weekly email: new broken links, sent to you.
  • Images: checks image sources too.
  • Bulk actions and CSV export.
  • Archive fix: point a dead link at its Wayback Machine copy in one click.

Privacy

Once you click Start checking links, it requests each linked URL to see if it works. The request names the plugin, not your site. Your content and visitor data are not sent anywhere. Private network addresses are skipped. Pro licences, the opt-in and the Pro plans page use Freemius (freemius.com), only when you choose them.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate it from Plugins > Add New.
  2. Open Tools > Sparrow Link Health and click Start checking links. Nothing is checked before that.
sections.faq:
Will it slow my site down?

No. Checks run in the background through WP-Cron, never while a visitor loads a page.

A big site shows as broken but opens fine for me.

Some sites block automated checks. Recheck it, and dismiss it if it stays listed.

Does it change my posts on its own?

Never. Links change only when you click Unlink or save a new URL. Button blocks and page-builder pages are left for you to edit in the editor.
